summary.headline: Charts do not clearly support a lower level; no recoverable amount
summary.rationale: 1000000067 billed 99215 on 6.4% of 1,836 claims against an expected 5.0% given patient complexity (risk-adjusted score 0.82; plain z-score vs peers -0.15). 36% of this provider's 99215 claims were on patients with 0 or 1 chronic conditions. Records came back for 30 claims. Of 4 documented 99215 claims, 1 (25%) were documented below the billed level, against 40% for the comparison providers. Note checks on 30 returned notes (share showing each sign): problems 47%, late 17%, unsigned 0%, data 23%. No audit trail was received. 24 of 24 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data reviewed had no lab or test line on the claim. 30 charts: only 1 below billed level (chart rule not triggered). Note signals (problems addressed 47%, duplicates 43%, late 17%) are present, but the 99215 share is only 1.26x expected and the recovery lower bound is $0, so a demand is not supported. Examples: C0032126: billed 99215; documented MDM level moderate, minutes not recorded. C0031561: billed 99215, patient aged 40 with 1 chronic condition(s) (obesity). C0031607: billed 99215, patient aged 60 with 0 chronic condition(s).
next_steps: 30 charts came back but do not settle it: request a targeted sample of 99215 charts, starting with C0032126, C0031561, C0031607.
Re-check after the targeted charts arrive; do not call upcoding or a sicker panel on this evidence alone.
